title: Site n'Omimi nke Olulu Mmiri ahụ
intro: Njem mkpụrụ obi nke otu nwa okorobịa malitere site n'ọhụụ dị ike nke ihe ndị dị n'eluigwe na-ehulata n'ofufe. Ndụ onye a bụ nke e ji aghụghọ kachasị ukwuu sitere n'aka ndị kacha nso, nke sochiri ya afọ nke ịbụ ohu na mkpọrọ na-ezighị ezi. Ma site n'okwukwe na-adịghị agbanwe agbanwe na nduzi Chineke, onye a si n'olulu dị ala bilie wee bụrụ otu n'ime ndị kacha ike n'alaeze ukwu. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta njirimara nke ohu Allah a dị ịrịba ama?
clues: E gosiri m ọhụụ nke kpakpando iri na otu, anyanwụ, na ọnwa ka ha na-akpọ isiala nye m.
Abụ m nwa nne m hụrụ n'anya nke ukwuu, nke kpalitere ekworo n'etiti ụmụnne m nwoke.
Ụmụnne m ndị nwoke jidere m, yipụ m uwe m, ma tụba m n'ime olulu mmiri gbara ọchịchịrị miri emi.
E rere m dị ka ihe ahịa n'ahịa ma buru m gaa ebe dị anya site n'obodo m
Otu nwanyị dị ike gbalịrị imebi nsọpụrụ m, a tụbakwara m n'ụlọ mkpọrọ maka ịjụ arịrịọ ya maka ya.
E nyere m onyinye nke nkọwa nrọ, m wee si n'onye mkpọrọ echefuru echefu bilie ruo n'onye isi minista nke Ijipt.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
